people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: Forty days were used for him, for that is how many the days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.
translations.bsb: taking the forty days required to complete the embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.
translations.kjv: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
translations.asv: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of embalming: and the Egyptians wept for him three-score and ten days.
